name: Pro Activity Timeline
description: Unified email, call, meeting, note, stage and task feed per account with bidirectional virtualised infinite scroll (TanStack Virtual + Query), dynamic row heights, sticky day headers, type filters, expandable email bodies, pinned notes, relative/absolute time and WAI-ARIA feed keyboard support.

props.name: queryKey
props.description: TanStack Query cache key for this feed; the active type filter is appended.

props.name: fetchPage
props.type: (req: { cursor, direction: "older" | "newer", types, signal }) => Promise<{ items, olderCursor, newerCursor }>
props.description: Server cursor source. Either this or items is required.

props.name: items
props.description: In-memory data, paged locally through the same code path (createLocalActivitySource).

props.name: anchor
props.description: Local mode: open the feed at this moment so newer items load when scrolling up.

props.name: availableTypes
props.description: Types shown in the filter bar. Default: email, call, meeting, note, stage, task.

props.name: timeMode / defaultTimeMode / onTimeModeChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled time display. Default relative.

props.name: pinnedIds / defaultPinnedIds / onPinnedIdsChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled pinned activities, shown above the feed.

props.name: pinnedItems
props.description: Pinned items that may be outside the loaded window.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the feed. Default "Activity".

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Explicit client; otherwise the nearest provider or a private one.
